chats.answer:
For home use, my top recommendation is the EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra if you want serious backup power during outages. If you're looking for something more affordable and portable, the Anker SOLIX F3800 series and Jackery Explorer 5000 Plus are also worth considering.

The best choice depends on whether you want to power a refrigerator and Wi-Fi for a day or keep much of your house running during a multi-day outage.

A solar generator is essentially a large rechargeable battery with an inverter and optional solar panels. Unlike a gas generator, it runs silently, produces no exhaust, and can be used indoors.

chats.answer:
For home use, the best solar generator depends on whether you want to power essential appliances during an outage or back up your entire house.

My top brands to consider are EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, BLUETTI, and Jackery.

One important distinction: a solar generator is generally a battery with an inverter and solar-charging capability. Unlike a gas generator, it doesn't produce electricity on demand without stored energy or sunlight.

For most homeowners, I'd prioritize battery capacity, expandable storage, 240V support, and home electrical integration over portability.
